item.title: Bill would let survivors request evidence be retested if a crime lab employee engaged in 'wrongful action'
item.description: A Colorado bill seeks to give survivors of a crime the ability to request forensic medical evidence be retested in their case, if a laboratory employee has engaged in "wrongful action."

item.title: Colorado skiers find inspiration in Lindsey Vonn, who says she'll compete in Winter Olympics after ACL injury
item.description: Vonn, who revealed she had a "completely ruptured" ACL on her left knee, said Tuesday she was “confident” she can compete at the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics beginning this week.

item.title: Beyond the settlement: Arapahoe County's $4 million bet on community-designed opioid recovery
item.description: As Arapahoe County leaders receives its latest opioid settlement funding, it's looking to partner with local organizations to help them shape countywide solutions to end the addiction cycle.
